scope: read-only current prompt interfaces for future sole fixed-scale1 E4 physical32 storage; no implementation or device proof

dispatch.fact: All four dense QKV projections finish first. Each real PreparedWide is then awaited separately through sliding_after_qkv; same-owner quarters are chronological. Only states.len() real quarters attend/commit; padded Tail256/384 tensor quarters do not own cache state.

Native metadata exists only for count128. Canonical+blocked+fused_head_attention+exact_sliding_attention chooses fused first128 at absolute start0, fused general otherwise. Both retain existing BF16 current K/V scratch, then commit all128 after attention. Deferred O returns only after commit.

Nonfused native uses blocked/canonical head producer, then first128, exact HeadRows, or original pooled diagnostic attention, then separate commit128. Legacy per-request BF16 storage remains a separate branch.

Partial17..127 uses sequential B16 prompt segments. Each segment has its own RoPE/masks/live count, runs heads_from_wide_tile, prompt-pool attention, live-prefix commit, then attention tile store. It is not independent-request B16 attention.

typed_adapters.current: BF16 [Rc64,Ts,Ns,Ds], Rc64 physical32; bases i32[P128/64] (two equal absolute ring byte offsets); gathered DM KeyRows=[Ns,Ts/32], elements[Ts%32,Ds].
typed_adapters.proposed_boundary: E4 pool gather plus table lookup to exactly the existing BF16 DM before unchanged contractions, masks, full1024 denominator and32-plane BF16 PV tree. Current-chunk Q/K/V remain BF16. First128 skips old reads entirely.

typed_adapters.current: Whole canonical pool plus base i32[1]. Prompt B16 old K gather uses Ts/8 distribution, V uses Ns,Ts/32; existing redistribution/tree remains. Original P128 diagnostic has its own row-local mapping.
typed_adapters.proposed_boundary: Separate E4 gather/lookup adapters or explicit shared decoded ring fallback preserving current typed attention APIs; do not assume current HeadRows adapter covers diagnostic/partial paths.

typed_adapters.current: All128 live: scatter axes[Rc64,Ts], payload[Ns,Ds], offsets i32[P128].
typed_adapters.proposed_boundary: E4 code scatter with halved sliding byte offsets after completed old-ring attention; no change to full-attention commit.

typed_adapters.current: VALID1..16 wrappers tile exactly the live prefix before scatter; same helper also serves independent decoders whose current token commit precedes attention.
typed_adapters.proposed_boundary: Preserve live-prefix dispatch and caller-specific ordering; convert only sliding payload/destination type and offsets.

address_rules.unchanged: RoPE offsets and all full-attention pool offsets remain BF16 byte units (*2); full pages stay Fc256. Existing ring IDs/ownership/context masks do not change.

quantization_boundary: Current q022 heads already cast original post-RoPE K / normalized V to E4 then lookup to BF16. A storage port must feed those same decoded values into current-chunk attention. Prefer retaining original codes for commit, or independently prove decoded BF16(E4)->E4 recast code identity (including signed zero/nonfinite policy); recast exactness is not established by this source review.
